'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Justin Montgomery LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Montgomery]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Profit
* '''Username:''' cardlicker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
